evidence.rootMotion: fixed root diagnostic; not an input locomotion test

sources.scope: Binary centre sampling explains coverage changes; not a pixel-art contour-selection algorithm.
Feature-aware contours and separate shape/pixel/temporal objectives. This local causal filter is not the paper's complete offline animation solver.

alternatives.method: Erode all thin pixels or use coverage threshold only
alternatives.decision: rejected; destroys authored tips and previous coverage-only evidence failed

alternatives.method: Geometry-constrained removal of raster-only local extrema

model.chain: Original VRM topology -> existing ScaleBake378 current skinned vertices -> output localToWorld -> view -> existing effectiveProjection -> 480x272 logical grid -> current visibility mask -> constrained deletion map -> existing Prepare/Restore/Join/OwnerLines -> native960 composition
model.space: Unity world metres, existing left-handed transform conventions; column-vector matrix product P*V*M. Logical texture origin bottom left, x right/y up, centre (x+.5,y+.5). One logical cell maps to two native pixels. No camera, scale, rotation, skinning or UV change.
model.authority: Current Animator bones and current GPU owner/depth remain authoritative. Mesh rest vertices only establish physical edge topology; current baked positions establish the contour.
model.eligible: One-cell outward extrema with three same-role/same-part inward support cells; body roles8..11 and parts2..5. Head/hair never edited. Existing selector edits and their neighbourhood are locked.
model.source: Exact piecewise-linear outward envelope of current projected triangles for the same material and body part over a three-cell tangent interval. Evaluate every envelope breakpoint, including edge intersections.
model.protection: Weld exact coincident rest-position vertices to distinguish UV seams from physical boundaries. Lock cells within one logical cell of any physical open mesh edge (hem/cuff). Retain source deviations greater than half a cell and reference-supported extrema.
model.selection: Delete only if source envelope deviates <=.5 logical px from its endpoint chord, chord places this centre outside, and new boundary stays <=1 logical px from source. These are the existing selector's .5px simplification and 1px boundary budgets, not new silhouette scale factors.
model.limits: Only this class of raster extrema is addressed; no claim that every legitimate silhouette endpoint or every animation brightness change should disappear. No temporal history occupancy is introduced.

invariants: No alpha additions: afterMask is a subset of beforeMask.
No changes to source meshes, rig, animation clips, materials, UVs, camera or pixel pitch.
No changes to head/hair, physical hem/cuff locks, source features exceeding .5px or same-role/part ownership guard.
Deletion may not break the three-cell inward support or change component/hole topology.
A/B captures use the same Animator pose/bone hash and same world buffer for each pair.
Compare actual 80-frame Walk at 60Hz; inspect full body and changed local regions.
Production integration only if runtime masks, protected features and visual comparison pass; no static pose translation substituted.
independentReview: No separate agent used. Author reviewed counterexamples (UV seams, real hems, head overlap, source intersections, foreground occlusion); these remain test obligations.
